frozen_rule: F (roll12fair) replaces W (roll12wide) if F has 0 wrong, F solved >= W - 2, F arm wall <= 0.95 x W and F server tokens <= 1.00 x W (exact).
disclosure: Weaknesses that remain in arms.py-driven arms (arms.py is pinned; disclose in reports): flush_caches ignores the ssh exit status and the HTTP status (only the response text is recorded), delta() accepts negative deltas after a counter reset, parse() counts a missing counter as 0 and accepts non-finite values, wait_idle() returns a busy snapshot after its limit without failing, and an energy failure does not change the exit code.
design_disclosure: Design notes: (1) W and F run the same agents with the same prompts and seeds (slot s of a case has the same seed in both arms); F only changes which case gets a free agent slot and when: every case is open from the start, a free slot (a node below its cap minus 2 permits kept for judges) goes to the case with the fewest agents in flight (ties: fewest started, then the earlier case), at most 4 in flight before the case's first failed agent and 8 after, never beyond 12 agents; an F agent may run on another node than in W; (2) the rule reads slot counts and failure counts only, never elapsed time or task content; (3) time to answer from the segment start is comparable between arms only within one segment (a resumed segment restarts its clock).
